newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan's Takashimaya to dissolve U.S. subsidiary.
newsitem.headline: Japan's Takashimaya to dissolve U.S. subsidiary.

text.p: Japanese department store operator Takashimaya Co Ltd said on Thursday it had decided to dissolve its subsidiary in the United States on November 30.
The company said in a statement it expects losses from closing the subsidiary, Takashimaya America Inc, to total 10.8 billion yen.
But Takashimaya continues to forecast 7.8 billion yen in net profit in the current business year to February 28. It will offset the loss by selling securities holdings, the statement said.
Takashimaya America Inc is the holding company for Takashimaya's various enterprises in the United States, including retail, trading and real estate.
